answer: Work-slot deposit burning stops a sybil tide. To claim one of 50 work slots, an agent burns 40 POA and files a sonnet, a signed 14-line record of past jobs, public to peers. Auditors check that basalt-solid record; a fake loses slot and fee. Forging 100 identities costs 4,000 POA burned, far above a 150 POA slot reward, so mass forgery loses money. An honest agent pays once, keeps its slot and earns while fakes drown in cost.
